consumer_fixture.recorded_source:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Componenta\Config\Config;
use Componenta\Config\ContainerValue;
use Componenta\Config\DependencyDefinitions;
use Componenta\Config\Environment;
use Componenta\DI\Attribute\Init;
use Componenta\DI\Attribute\SetUp;
use Componenta\DI\Attribute\Transform;
use Componenta\DI\Container;
use Componenta\DI\ContainerFactory;
use Componenta\DI\Definition\ClassDefinition;
use Componenta\DI\Definition\Definition;
use Componenta\DI\Definition\DefinitionInterface;
use Componenta\DI\Exception\InvalidConfigurationException;
use Componenta\DI\Exception\MutationRetirementException;
use Componenta\DI\Exception\ResolutionException;
use Componenta\DI\Internal\AliasResolver;
use Componenta\DI\ProxyFactory;
use Componenta\DI\Resolver\Entry\CompositeResolver;
use Componenta\DI\Resolver\Entry\DefinitionResolverInterface;
use Componenta\DI\Resolver\Entry\FactoryResolver;
use Componenta\DI\Resolver\Entry\InvokableResolver;
use Composer\InstalledVersions;

function verify(bool $condition, string $description): void
{
    if (!$condition) {
        throw new RuntimeException($description);
    }
}

$installedSource = realpath(__DIR__ . '/vendor/componenta/di/src');
verify($installedSource !== false, 'The test requires an installed consumer package.');
$sourceMap = [
    'Container' => (new ReflectionClass(Container::class))->getFileName(),
    'Transform' => (new ReflectionClass(Transform::class))->getFileName(),
    'Internal functions' => (new ReflectionFunction('Componenta\\DI\\Internal\\is_entry_class_eligible'))->getFileName(),
];
foreach ($sourceMap as $name => $path) {
    verify($path !== false && str_starts_with($path, $installedSource . '/'), $name . ' loaded from outside the installed package.');
}
verify(!class_exists('Componenta\\DI\\Tests\\Support\\ContainerBuilder'), 'Development test helpers must not be autoloaded in a production consumer.');
verify(!interface_exists('Componenta\\DI\\Resolver\\Entry\\DefinitionAwareResolverInterface'), 'The superseded mutable definition interface must not remain.');

final readonly class Message
{
    public function __construct(public string $text) {}
}

final class ConsumerNormalizer
{
    public function normalize(string $value): string
    {
        return strtoupper(trim($value));
    }
}

function initialLabel(): string
{
    return ' seed ';
}

define('DI_CONSUMER_TRANSFORM', static function (string $value, ConsumerNormalizer $normalizer): string {
    return $normalizer->normalize($value);
});
define('DI_CONSUMER_SETUP', static function (CallbackObject $object, ConsumerNormalizer $normalizer): void {
    $object->setup = $normalizer->normalize($object->name . ':' . $object->initial);
});

#[SetUp(DI_CONSUMER_SETUP)]
final class CallbackObject
{
    #[Init('initialLabel')]
    #[Transform(DI_CONSUMER_TRANSFORM)]
    public readonly string $initial;

    public string $setup;

    public function __construct(#[Transform(DI_CONSUMER_TRANSFORM)] public string $name) {}
}

$environment = new Environment([]);
$config = new Config(['application' => 'consumer'], $environment);
$value = (new ContainerFactory())->create($config, new DependencyDefinitions([
    'factories' => ['message' => Definition::factory(static fn(ContainerValue $context, array $params): Message => new Message($params['text'] ?? $context->config->string('application')))],
]));
$container = $value->container;
verify($container instanceof Container, 'The default factory must return the public container.');
verify($value->config === $config && $container->get(Config::class) === $config && $container->get(Environment::class) === $environment, 'Configuration and environment identity changed.');
$shared = $container->get('message');
verify($shared instanceof Message && $shared->text === 'consumer' && $container->get('message') === $shared, 'Factory ABI or shared identity changed.');
$fresh = $container->make('message', ['text' => 'fresh']);
verify($fresh instanceof Message && $fresh->text === 'fresh' && $fresh !== $shared, 'Fresh construction must honor runtime parameters.');
$override = new Message('override');
$container->set('message', $override);
verify($container->get('message') === $override && $container->make('message')->text === 'consumer', 'Raw set must retain the underlying fresh definition.');

$container->set('reference', new Message('old'));
$container->set('defined', ClassDefinition::create(Message::class)->constructor(['text' => 'configured']));
verify($container->make('defined')->text === 'configured' && $container->make('defined', ['text' => 'literal'])->text === 'literal', 'ClassDefinition construction or literal override failed.');
$container->set('reference-copy', Definition::factory(static fn(ContainerValue $context): Message => $context->container->get('reference')));
$oldReference = $container->make('reference-copy');
$container->set('reference', new Message('new'));
verify($container->make('reference-copy')->text === 'new' && $oldReference->text === 'old', 'Fresh factories must observe current referenced services.');

$strategy = new FactoryResolver($container, new ProxyFactory());
$validated = $strategy->validateDefinition('direct', Definition::factory(static fn(): Message => new Message('direct')));
verify($strategy->resolveDefinition('direct', $validated)->text === 'direct', 'The direct factory strategy migration failed.');
$invokable = new InvokableResolver();
$validated = $invokable->validateDefinition('object', Definition::invokable(stdClass::class));
verify($invokable->resolveDefinition('object', $validated) instanceof stdClass, 'The direct invokable strategy migration failed.');

final readonly class TextDefinition implements DefinitionInterface
{
    public function __construct(public string $value) {}
}

final readonly class ValidatedText implements DefinitionInterface
{
    public function __construct(public string $value) {}
}

final class TextStrategy implements DefinitionResolverInterface
{
    public function supportsDefinition(DefinitionInterface $definition): bool
    {
        return $definition instanceof TextDefinition;
    }

    public function validateDefinition(string $id, DefinitionInterface $definition): DefinitionInterface
    {
        if (!$definition instanceof TextDefinition || trim($definition->value) === '') {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('A nonempty text definition is required.');
        }

        return new ValidatedText(trim($definition->value));
    }

    public function resolveDefinition(string $id, DefinitionInterface $validated, array $params = []): mixed
    {
        if (!$validated instanceof ValidatedText) {
            throw new LogicException('Execution received an unvalidated definition.');
        }

        return $validated->value;
    }
}

$child = new CompositeResolver(new TextStrategy());
$child->setDefinition('text', new TextDefinition(' original '));
$snapshot = new CompositeResolver($child);
$child->setDefinition('text', new TextDefinition('changed'));
verify($snapshot->resolve('text') === 'original' && $child->resolve('text') === 'changed', 'A nested composition must preserve its independent snapshot.');
$attached = new Container($snapshot, new AliasResolver(), $container);
$attached->set('text', new TextDefinition('attached update'));
verify($attached->get('text') === 'attached update', 'A custom definition strategy must work through the public container.');
try {
    $snapshot->setDefinition('text', new TextDefinition('invalid authority'));
    throw new LogicException('Direct mutation of an attached root must fail.');
} catch (InvalidConfigurationException) {
    verify($attached->get('text') === 'attached update', 'An attached-root rejection must retain the current shared service.');
}

$object = $container->make(CallbackObject::class, ['name' => ' alice ', 'object' => new stdClass()]);
verify($object instanceof CallbackObject && $object->name === 'ALICE' && $object->initial === 'SEED' && $object->setup === 'ALICE:SEED', 'Installed callback composition, property staging or reserved setup argument failed.');
$transformed = $container->call(static fn(#[Transform(DI_CONSUMER_TRANSFORM)] string $value): string => $value, ['value' => ' isolated ', 'normalizer' => 'outer input']);
verify($transformed === 'ISOLATED', 'Transform suffix resolution must not inherit the caller input bag.');

interface FirstService {}
interface SecondService {}
final class FirstImplementation implements FirstService {}
final class SecondImplementation implements SecondService {}
final readonly class UnionConsumer
{
    public function __construct(public FirstService|SecondService $service) {}
}

$first = new FirstImplementation();
$container->set(FirstService::class, $first);
verify($container->make(UnionConsumer::class)->service === $first, 'The sole available union service must be selected.');
$secondCalls = 0;
$container->set(SecondService::class, Definition::factory(static function () use (&$secondCalls): SecondImplementation {
    ++$secondCalls;

    return new SecondImplementation();
}));
try {
    $container->make(UnionConsumer::class);
    throw new LogicException('Two available service arms must be rejected.');
} catch (ResolutionException) {
    verify($secondCalls === 0, 'Ambiguity must be detected before constructing candidates.');
}

final class RetiredValue
{
    public function __destruct()
    {
        throw new RuntimeException('consumer retirement');
    }
}

$container->set('retired', Definition::factory(static fn(): RetiredValue => new RetiredValue()));
$container->get('retired');
try {
    $container->set('retired', Definition::factory(static fn(): Message => new Message('committed')));
    throw new LogicException('The synchronous retirement failure must be reported.');
} catch (MutationRetirementException $failure) {
    verify($failure->id === 'retired' && count($failure->causes) === 1 && $failure->getPrevious()?->getMessage() === 'consumer retirement', 'The committed-outcome diagnostic lost its context or cause.');
    verify($container->get('retired')->text === 'committed' && $container->make('retired')->text === 'committed', 'Shared and fresh lookup must agree after a retirement failure.');
}

echo json_encode([
    'php' => PHP_VERSION,
    'package_version' => InstalledVersions::getPrettyVersion('componenta/di'),
    'source_map' => $sourceMap,
    'no_dev_helpers' => true,
    'construction_and_config_identity' => true,
    'raw_set_and_fresh_definition' => true,
    'direct_strategy_migration' => true,
    'custom_strategy_snapshot_and_authority' => true,
    'callbacks_and_transform_isolation' => true,
    'union_selection_and_ambiguity' => true,
    'committed_retirement_outcome' => true,
], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES), "\n";
